threat_event: Ransomware on the business laptop encrypts working files and steals county extracts and city exports
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Daily local administrator account; built-in antivirus only; county extracts kept past the deletion date; no off-device backup of scripts; no security training beyond CJIS awareness
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 laptop; SYS-02 sync folder; BP-02; BP-03
regulatory_driver: Contract CL-01 (SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) and (6)(a)
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; automatic updates; built-in antivirus; MFA on SaaS accounts
treatment_plan: Standard account for daily work; delete county phase 1 extracts; encrypted backup of project folders and scripts; yearly security course; P08 runbook

threat_event: Attacker uses credentials or a live session stolen from the laptop (infostealer or phishing) to reach the sheriff's virtual desktop or the county case management SaaS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Browser keeps agency sessions signed in; daily administrator account lets malware read browser data; the owner is the weak path into three agency systems
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05 agency accounts; SYS-01 laptop; BP-02
regulatory_driver: Contract CL-01 (SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate); N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 AC-17; IA-2)
existing_controls: County MFA; sheriff hardware token (cannot be copied by malware); host firewall
treatment_plan: Standard daily account; sign out of agency systems at the end of each session and never save agency passwords in the browser; phishing training; report any suspicious sign-in to the agency within its clock

threat_event: County phase 1 extracts are kept past the contract deletion date on the laptop, in the sync folder, and on the USB drive
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No data inventory or deletion routine; contract required deletion and certification by 2026-06-28
regulatory_driver: Contract CL-01 (SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2)
treatment_plan: Delete every copy, empty the cloud recycle bin, and send the county a written deletion certificate; keep a data location log for each agency (POL-01 8.4)

threat_event: The unencrypted USB backup drive is lost or stolen, exposing names with driver license numbers for about 2,100 county residents
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Drive unencrypted; kept in an unlocked desk drawer; holds county extracts
regulatory_driver: Contract CL-01 (SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) and (6)(a)
existing_controls: Drive stays in the home office
treatment_plan: Wipe and encrypt the drive (or replace it with an encrypted drive); remove county data; keep it in the locked file box

threat_event: City applicant documents sent to a consumer-grade AI assistant are kept or used by the provider; the city may have to notify residents
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AI assistant used with real data before any terms review or city approval; model-improvement setting was on
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-08 AI assistant; 25 city applications (6 with Social Security numbers)
existing_controls: Conversations deleted and setting turned off 2026-08-12; city told 2026-08-13
treatment_plan: No agency data in any AI tool without the agency's written approval and a data agreement; support the city's notice decision; P10

threat_event: A county attestation review or a sheriff or CJIS audit finds no written security program, and the owner loses access or the contract
threat_source: Agency client or CJIS Systems Agency
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written policy, risk assessment, or deletion records before 2026-09-15; the Security Addendum requires a security program consistent with the CJIS Security Policy
regulatory_driver: N92-R02 (Security Addendum 3.01); Contract CL-01 (SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate)
treatment_plan: Keep POL-01, P01, and P07 current; answer the county attestation with them; yearly review each August

threat_event: An attacker or infected family device on the home Wi-Fi attacks the laptop or changes the router's settings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default router admin password; old firmware; one network shared with family devices
existing_controls: SaaS and agency traffic uses TLS; host firewall on
treatment_plan: New router admin password; firmware update; separate work Wi-Fi network

threat_event: Email account takeover or a look-alike domain sends an agency a fake invoice or a bank change request
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agencies pay to bank details in the owner's invoices; no agreed way to confirm changes
existing_controls: MFA on email; provider spam filtering
treatment_plan: Tell each agency's payables contact in writing that bank details never change by email and must be confirmed by phone; monthly sign-in review

threat_event: The owner is suddenly unavailable or loses the only phone, so no one meets the 1-hour CJIS or 24-hour county reporting clock or tells agencies about missed milestones
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One person holds every role and credential; every MFA prompt but one goes to one phone; no recovery codes; no backup arrangement
regulatory_driver: Contract CL-01 (SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate); N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 IR-6)
treatment_plan: Printed agency contact sheet; sealed recovery codes with the owner's attorney; second MFA method; peer backup agreement (P05)

threat_event: The laptop fails or is lost, and with no spare and no copy of the scripts the owner misses a booked county load window
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single three-year-old laptop; scripts only in a local repository; backup copies the documents folder only
existing_controls: Sync folder for most project files
treatment_plan: Push the scripts repository to the business cloud storage daily; written laptop build checklist; same-day replacement plan (P05)

threat_event: Someone signs in to the city 311 system with the owner's password-only account or the forgotten 2024 account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: City offers contractors no MFA; 2024 project account never disabled
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05 city 311 accounts; city constituent data
existing_controls: Unique long password from the password manager
treatment_plan: Ask the city to disable the 2024 account and to offer MFA (requested 2026-08-24); confirm in writing

threat_event: A security incident is not recognized, or the owner misses an agency reporting clock (1 hour sheriff, 24 hours county, 10 days under Fla. Stat. 501.171(6)(a))
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan, written clocks, or contact sheet before 2026-09-15
regulatory_driver: N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 IR-6); Contract CL-01 (SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate); Fla. Stat. 501.171(6)(a)
existing_controls: Owner knows the agency contacts by name
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and notification matrix; print the contact sheet; walk through the runbook with the IT technician

threat_event: The productivity suite is down or the owner is locked out for most of a working day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Email and files depend on one SaaS provider
existing_controls: Provider availability commitments (SOC 2 report, P09); agency contacts reachable by phone
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Agency phone numbers stay on the printed contact sheet

threat_event: A hurricane cuts power and internet at the home office for several days
existing_controls: All agency systems and files are cloud-reachable from any clean device with MFA; phone hotspot
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Take the laptop, phone, token, and contact sheet when an evacuation order is issued

threat_event: CJI copied out of the sheriff's virtual desktop sits on the laptop and in cloud storage, outside the sheriff's control (found in P07 testing)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Virtual desktop allowed clipboard and drive mapping; the owner did not treat test output as CJI; no data location checks
regulatory_driver: N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 AC-20; SC-28; IR-6; Security Addendum 3.01)
existing_controls: Reported to the LASO within 1 hour on 2026-08-25; file deleted; sheriff disabled clipboard and drive mapping 2026-08-26
treatment_plan: Data location rule (no CJI outside the virtual desktop); quarterly search of the laptop and cloud storage for agency data; CJIS refresher training by 2026-11-18 with this incident as the lesson
